summary.name: Gumloop
summary.one_liner: Gumloop is an AI agent platform for building agents that use your tools and data to do work, then automating them with triggers, schedules, and an API.
keywords: connect tools and data to ai
use_cases: automate recurring work with ai agents
connect ai to company tools and data
run ai agents on a schedule
expose ai agents through an api
summary.what_it_does: The page is the getting-started introduction to Gumloop's documentation. It describes Gumloop as an AI agent platform for building agents that use a user's tools and data to do real work. Agents can be automated using triggers, schedules, and an API. The page also links to a documentation index and a way to chat with the docs in an AI tool, plus a support contact. It contains little detail beyond this overview.
notable: Agents can be automated with triggers, schedules, and an API
Documentation index available at /llms.txt for discovering pages
Docs can be chatted with from an external AI tool
caveats: Page does not describe specific integrations or limits
